# Last updated: 2026-06-11

> UNDRGRND is a kids movement studio on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia, serving Surfers Paradise and surrounding areas. We teach pole, aerial silks and aerial yoga foundation classes to children aged 6 to 17 in a safe, supportive, non-competitive environment. Classes are foundation-focused and beginner-friendly, grouped by age (Junior 6–8, Intermediate 9–12, Senior 13–17). Class locations are flexible and confirmed when you get in touch.

## Business Information
- **Name:** UNDRGRND
- **Type:** Kids movement / dance studio (pole, aerial silks, aerial yoga)
- **Ages:** 6–17 years
- **Phone:** 0721 402 690
- **Email:** undrgrndgc@gmail.com
- **Service Area:** Surfers Paradise & surrounding areas, Gold Coast, QLD, Australia
- **Pricing:** $35 per class, booked by the term
- **Enrol:** https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/enrol

## Programs
- **Pole Foundations** (Junior 6–8, Intermediate 9–12, Senior 13–17) — strength, coordination and confidence on the pole. https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/pole-foundations
- **Aerial Foundations** (Junior 6–8, Intermediate 9–12, Senior 13–17) — aerial silks: grip strength, control and courage. https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/aerial-foundations
- **Aerial Yoga Foundations** (all ages 6–17) — supported movement, flexibility, balance and calm in a hammock. https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/aerial-yoga-foundations

## Age Groups
- **Junior** — 6–8 years
- **Intermediate** — 9–12 years
- **Senior** — 13–17 years

## FAQ
**What ages?** Children 6–17, grouped Junior (6–8), Intermediate (9–12), Senior (13–17).
**Experience needed?** No — every class is foundation-focused and beginner-friendly.
**Is it safe?** Yes — qualified, Working With Children Checked instructors, small groups, professionally installed and inspected equipment.
**Cost / booking?** $35 per class, booked by the term. Enrol at https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/enrol or get in touch.
